directChecks.method: Parse actual BREP, subtract actual layer drill union, union GND polygons; logical source memberships select GND only.

directChecks.method: Independently intersect each actual 0.70 mm outer annulus, after subtracting actual drills, with actual largest GND region; 64 segments per quadrant.

directChecks.measurement: Inner1 non-ground signal trace count and summed planar lengths
directChecks.method: Actual consecutive same-layer wire vertices; duplicate endpoints and vertical transfers contribute zero.

Intersect actual top centerlines with complement of actual drilled inner1 GND plane. This includes terminal antipads and intentional switch-node exclusion; gaps are screening observations, not confirmed missing returns. Full results preserved in own checks JSON.

strengths: One large, contiguous actual GND reference plane survives the signal slots; fresh geometry reproduced the prior 6613.7444847 mm² value.

Every one of 166 ground barrels has substantial finite connection to that largest plane, with fresh minimum annular contact 0.3033 mm². This is much stronger DC evidence than a logical net label or endpoint join.
Wide capacitor return sections, multiple local barrels and dedicated short quiet-ground stubs are documented against the same exact capture; these are appropriate local power-routing choices.

findings.explanation: Nine non-ground signal traces use inner1, for 327.93 mm of total planar wire length. Their foreign-net clearance slots cut long corridors into the GND reference plane. TEC_SAFE_EN alone uses two 71.66 mm and 52.35 mm trunks. The plane remains DC-connected, but these corridors force lateral return-current detours for signals crossing them and reduce routing economy. The geometrical cuts are confirmed; added inductance/noise magnitude is inferred and has not been simulated or measured.

The same-capture critical-reference check explicitly retains 0.34176537829136944 mm² of inherited GND projection support loss for PD_PROTECTED_DISCHARGE_FEED. Its pass means there was no NEW support loss relative to Source22; it does not mean every critical trace has a fully uninterrupted reference below it. This is a routing refinement target, not a confirmed DC open or short. The inherited magnitude is taken from the bound existing report, not recomputed against older captures here.

166 direct contacts and common GND membership establish ideal static connection. They do not establish each fast-edge/switching return loop impedance, cross-slot return path, or stackup reference spacing. The report correctly limits its acceptance to static routing; routing should not be rated exceptional merely from these pass counts.

suspectedShortAssessment.explanation: Ground reference geometry checks did not expose an accidental GND tie. Clearance slots around foreign-net inner1 signals are intentional isolation geometry, not shorts. The user crop requires separate exact net/layer identification and foreign-copper intersection analysis; this ground-only review neither proves nor dismisses that suspected short.

limitations: This is a read-only static geometrical review of exact circuit SHA 3ac5; no PCB changes, solver, autorouter or fabrication exports were run.

Ground region/via contacts and inner1 lengths were freshly measured. Existing capacitor contact/critical support receipts were inspected as supporting evidence; no full old/new support re-computation or impedance extraction was done.
No exact mapping of the crop was completed by this ground-specific role; other reviewers own that work.
No deduction was applied solely because the hardware is unbuilt. Score deductions address observed reference-plane slot routing and its qualified electrical implications.
topImprovements: Keep inner1 as a GND reference wherever possible by moving the longest SAFE_EN/debug and fault trunks to the signal routing layers or moving their endpoints closer; shorten slots rather than adding many unnecessary vias.

For remaining plane-slot crossings, explicitly audit local return routes and paired ground transfers using the actual layer stack. Add ground stitching only where it provides a verified alternate return path, not arbitrary decorative via fill.
Prioritize the known protected discharge reference gap and nearby sensitive controls when arranging short local returns; do not treat no-new-loss as zero-loss.
